# Exact snapshot of the local environment this branch's neural smoke and guard suite were
# actually validated in (docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md, "Validation record"). Generated by
# `pip freeze` after `pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-neural.txt` in a fresh
# venv on Python 3.12.3 -- not invented, not aspirational.
#
# This is NOT the environment the reported headline numbers in
# docs/RESULTS_AND_LIMITATIONS.md came from -- those ran on the cluster's own environment
# (Python 3.10.20, numpy 2.2.6, torch 2.6.0+cu124 -- read directly from a committed task
# artifact, results/selected/main_benchmark/tasks/*.json's own "environment" field). Bit-for-
# bit numeric equality between the two environments is NOT promised -- see
# docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md, "Numeric tolerances," for what is: the tests in
# tests/test_selected_benchmark_provenance.py, which run in THIS environment, re-derive the
# reported numbers from committed artefacts, not from a fresh model run, so they are unaffected
# by this gap. tests/test_herald93_guards.py and tests/run_herald93_mutations.py DO run the
# model fresh in this environment, and were the ones actually validated against these exact
# pins (docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md, "Validation record").
#
# Install with: pip install -r environment-neural-validated.txt
# (equivalent in practice to requirements.txt + requirements-neural.txt, pinned exactly)
